OCR files copied unchanged from the open-source packages tesseract.js 7.0.0 (tesseract.min.js, worker.min.js),
tesseract.js-core 7.0.0 (the two tesseract-core-*.wasm.js engines) and @tesseract.js-data/eng 1.0.0
(eng.traineddata.gz, the "best_int" English model). All Apache License 2.0 (LICENSE-core.txt).
They are served from this site itself so reading a photo never contacts another server.
